# third_party

Single-header libraries compiled into the port (by `as4_text.c` and `as4_audio.c`):

| File | Version | Upstream | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stb_truetype.h` | v1.28 (nothings/stb @ 9600522) | https://github.com/nothings/stb | public domain / MIT (dual) |
| `dr_mp3.h` | v0.7.x (mackron/dr_libs @ 0901cdc) | https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs | public domain / MIT-0 (dual) |
| `dr_wav.h` | (mackron/dr_libs @ 0901cdc) | https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs | public domain / MIT-0 (dual) |

They are unmodified; each file carries its license text at the end.
They are code only: no game data.
